title: Juice overview
description: Starter dashboard: traffic and failures from traces, Juice mediator/messaging/delivery metrics, warning logs, host metrics.

panels.title: Requests and messages handled
panels.description: Server spans (HTTP requests) and consumer spans (messages processed) per interval.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS t, concat(ServiceName, ' · ', SpanKind) AS series, count() AS value
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind IN ('Server', 'Consumer') AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t

SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS t, concat(ServiceName, ' · ', SpanName) AS series, count() AS value
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind IN ('Server', 'Consumer') AND StatusCode = 'Error' AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t

SELECT ServiceName AS service, SpanName AS operation, SpanKind AS kind, count() AS calls,
       countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') AS errors,
       round(quantile(0.5)(Duration) / 1e6, 2) AS p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6, 2) AS p95_ms
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY service, operation, kind ORDER BY p95_ms DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT t, label, sum(delta) AS value FROM (
  SELECT t, label, v - lagInFrame(v, 1, if(StartTimeUnix >= $__fromTime, 0, v)) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, Attributes, StartTimeUnix ORDER BY t) AS delta
  FROM (
    SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS t, ServiceName, Attributes, StartTimeUnix, Attributes['juice.operation'] AS label, max(Value) AS v
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'juice.mediator.requests' AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote}) AND 1
    GROUP BY t, ServiceName, Attributes, StartTimeUnix, label
  )
)
GROUP BY t, label ORDER BY t

SELECT t, label, sum(delta) AS value FROM (
  SELECT t, label, v - lagInFrame(v, 1, if(StartTimeUnix >= $__fromTime, 0, v)) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, Attributes, StartTimeUnix ORDER BY t) AS delta
  FROM (
    SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS t, ServiceName, Attributes, StartTimeUnix, concat(Attributes['juice.operation'], ' · ', Attributes['error.type']) AS label, max(Value) AS v
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'juice.mediator.errors' AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote}) AND 1
    GROUP BY t, ServiceName, Attributes, StartTimeUnix, label
  )
)
GROUP BY t, label ORDER BY t

SELECT t, label, sum(delta) AS value FROM (
  SELECT t, label, v - lagInFrame(v, 1, if(StartTimeUnix >= $__fromTime, 0, v)) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, Attributes, StartTimeUnix ORDER BY t) AS delta
  FROM (
    SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS t, ServiceName, Attributes, StartTimeUnix, concat(Attributes['juice.message_type'], ' · ', Attributes['juice.dispatch.result']) AS label, max(Value) AS v
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'juice.messaging.consumed' AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote}) AND 1
    GROUP BY t, ServiceName, Attributes, StartTimeUnix, label
  )
)
GROUP BY t, label ORDER BY t

panels.title: Outbox delivery outcomes
panels.description: From AddJuiceDeliveryMetrics(): delivery attempts that succeeded or failed, per publisher.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t, label, sum(delta) AS value FROM (
  SELECT t, label, v - lagInFrame(v, 1, if(StartTimeUnix >= $__fromTime, 0, v)) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, MetricName, Attributes, StartTimeUnix ORDER BY t) AS delta
  FROM (
    SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS t, ServiceName, MetricName, Attributes, StartTimeUnix,
           concat(Attributes['publisher'], ' · ', replaceRegexpOne(MetricName, '^delivery_(.*)_total$', '\\1')) AS label, max(Value) AS v
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('delivery_success_total', 'delivery_failure_total') AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
    GROUP BY t, ServiceName, MetricName, Attributes, StartTimeUnix, label
  )
)
GROUP BY t, label ORDER BY t

SELECT Timestamp AS timestamp, SeverityText AS level, Body AS body, ServiceName AS service, ScopeName AS category,
       LogAttributes['juice.correlation_id'] AS correlation_id, TraceId AS traceID
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SeverityNumber >= 13 AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS t, ResourceAttributes['host.name'] AS host, avg(Value) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'system.memory.usage' AND Attributes['state'] = 'used'
GROUP BY t, host ORDER BY t

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS t, ResourceAttributes['host.name'] AS host, avg(Value) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'system.cpu.load_average.1m'
GROUP BY t, host ORDER BY t
